locators.locator: Dinsmoor, David A.; to Medtronic, Inc.; Spinal cord injury therapy based on evoked compound action potentials; patent 12642969
US 12,642,969 B2 front matter: 21 claims, application 17/810,459, prior publication US 2023/0047655 A1; claim 1: SCI symptom therapy adjusted using sensed ECAP characteristics

decision: Official USPTO record confirms the June 2 2026 grant and its 2023 application publication. Claim 1 concerns spinal-cord-injury symptom therapy and ECAP feedback; it does not establish an analgesic outcome or empirical validation.
remaining: Check later corrections, reexamination and family updates at a subsequent dated cut; the Official Gazette entry alone does not prove global absence of updates. SRC-07 remains open.
